_meta.purpose: Ground-truth fraud cases for evaluating the medical-coding 'coding expert' agent and for driving the guided tour. Each case is detectable from note text alone.
_meta.note: See docs/eval-cases.md for the curated registry and docs/eval-cases-research.md for the research subagent's expanded set.

cases.note_text:
CC: Annual wellness visit.

History: 68yo male presents for Medicare annual wellness visit. Reports feeling well overall. On lisinopril for blood pressure, well-controlled. Denies chest pain, dyspnea, cough, edema, or urinary symptoms. No recent hospitalizations.

Exam: BP 128/78, HR 70. Lungs clear bilaterally, no wheezes or crackles. Heart regular rate and rhythm. No peripheral edema. Extremities normal.

Assessment/Plan:
1. Essential hypertension, well-controlled - continue lisinopril.
2. Medicare annual wellness visit completed, no new concerns.

correct_codes.description: Encounter for general adult medical exam without abnormal findings

billed_codes.description: Encounter for general adult medical exam without abnormal findings

billed_codes.flag_reason: No renal labs (creatinine/eGFR), no CKD history, no nephrology mention anywhere in note
billed_codes.billing_impact_note: N18.3 is an HCC (hierarchical condition category) code. In Medicare Advantage risk-adjusted payment, adding this code increases the patient's risk score and the plan's capitated payment, without any procedure or higher E/M level being billed.

cases.note_text:
CC: Follow-up for hypertension.

History: 62yo male presents for routine BP check. Reports good adherence to amlodipine. Denies chest pain, dyspnea, palpitations, leg swelling, or headache. No recent ER visits or hospitalizations.

Exam: BP 132/84, HR 72, regular. Heart: regular rate and rhythm, no murmurs, no S3/S4. Lungs clear bilaterally. No peripheral edema. No JVD.

Assessment/Plan:
1. Essential hypertension, well-controlled - continue amlodipine, recheck in 6 months.

billed_codes.description: Hypertensive heart disease without heart failure
billed_codes.flag_reason: No cardiac abnormality documented — exam explicitly notes no S3/S4, no murmurs, no JVD, no edema; nothing supports heart involvement
billed_codes.billing_impact_note: I11.9 (hypertensive heart disease) carries a higher complexity than I10 (essential hypertension). In fee-for-service it upcodes the E/M medical decision-making to a higher-paying level and, as a chronic cardiac condition, can raise the patient's risk score.

cases.note_text:
CC: Pre-op cardiac clearance.

History: 55yo female referred for ECG prior to elective cholecystectomy. Denies chest pain, palpitations, or dyspnea. Hypertension well-controlled on losartan.

Exam: BP 124/80, HR 68. Heart regular rate and rhythm, no murmurs. Lungs clear. No edema.

Assessment/Plan: 12-lead ECG performed, normal sinus rhythm, no acute ischemic changes. Cleared for surgery. Continue losartan.

billed_codes.flag_reason: 93005 is the technical component bundled into the complete ECG 93000 already billed; the note documents a single 12-lead ECG, not a separate tracing service
billed_codes.billing_impact_note: Billing 93000 (complete ECG) and 93005 (its bundled technical component) separately — usually with a -59 modifier to bypass the NCCI edit — double-bills the technical component, collecting for one service twice.

cases.note_text:
CC: Cough, 1 week.

History: 44yo male with productive cough, no fever, no dyspnea. Denies chest pain or palpitations. No smoking history.

Exam: BP 118/76, HR 74, afebrile. Lungs: few scattered rhonchi, no wheezes, no crackles. Heart regular. No edema.

Assessment/Plan: Acute bronchitis. Symptomatic care, fluids, return if worsening. No cardiac workup indicated or performed.

billed_codes.flag_reason: The note documents an uncomplicated respiratory visit with no cardiac complaint and explicitly states no cardiac workup was performed; an ECG was never done
billed_codes.billing_impact_note: A service billed with no supporting documentation — the ECG (93000) was never rendered. The provider collects the full fee for a service the patient never received.

cases._clone_note: This note is verbatim-identical across several encounters for different patients. The detection signal is cross-encounter note similarity (cosine / hash match), not anything visible within a single note.

correct_codes.description: Office visit, established patient, low complexity

billed_codes.description: Office visit, established patient, high complexity
billed_codes.flag_reason: The note is a verbatim clone of other encounters (identical history and exam), indicating boilerplate unedited from a template; and the note supports 99213, not 99214
billed_codes.billing_impact_note: Cloned notes let a provider bill the same higher-level E/M across many patients with no individualized documentation, compounding the overpayment per cloned encounter.
